The published `helix-db` 3.0.0 crate provides the query DSL, request types, async HTTP client, native graph helpers, and a feature-gated embedded client.
The published `@helix-db/helix-db` 3.1.0 package targets Node.js 20 or newer and emits the same operation-tree AST as the Rust, Go, and Python SDKs.
The Go SDK builds the shared operation-tree AST and executes requests through a typed HTTP client.
The Python SDK is published on PyPI as `helix-db` 0.3.4 and imported as `helixdb`.
The HelixDB HTTP API accepts operation-tree queries at `POST /v2/query`. The same contract is available from a local server and a Helix Cloud gateway.
Helix Cloud exposes one public MCP endpoint: `https://mcp.helix-db.com/mcp` Query, observability, and customer administration tools share this endpoint.
All API requests to Helix Cloud are authenticated with a Bearer token. Tokens are managed through the Helix dashboard.
